title: Build a small lossless video codec
audience: Students with basic programming competence and prior assembly/MSA experience

environment.memoryLayout: Student-owned ordinary data in the first two MiB; reserved separate grading arenas and 32768-byte private stack

progression.localImplementation: Native stage-local observations and public completed checks; remote progression is pending

prerequisites: Native MIPS64 memory and calling conventions
Numeric RGB words and MSA word/vector operations
learningObjectives: Encode and recover exact frame sequences using full/XOR records
Validate whole files before directory and picture publication
Keep failed-call state according to each interface contract
Seek independently and play sequentially with anchored deadlines
Compare correct scalar/MSA work and valid representation choices

functionContract.profile: MLV1 64x64 RGB, one through 256 frames, period 1..64, duration 1..1000ms
functionContract.publication: Interface-specific: playback failure retains actual accepted pictures; file staging/work may change, final fields publish only on success
